Implement target filtering for selfFollower (including traitsAny) or add an effect like buffFieldTrait/choose-target-by-filter for allied followers, then encode this as buff +1/+1 to another Angel or Fallen Angel follower you control.

The condition is incorrect: it requires at least 5 cards named Onion Patch in your cemetery, not just any 5 cards. Encode this with a named-card cemetery condition; add an implemented condition such as ownCemeteryNamedMin { identityName: "Onion Patch", count: 5 }.

The granted ability is misencoded as Last Words; it should grant Storm and a Strike ability that deals 1 damage to an enemy follower. Encode the second clause as a granted Strike trigger, but the engine lacks an operation to grant triggered abilities like Strike conditionally; implement an effect such as grantTriggeredAbility/grantStrike, then use it here.
